description_en: List all automatic snapshot policies that you created in a region and that match your query conditions
description_zh: 查询您在某个地域下，所有已创建的符合查询条件的自动快照策略
kebab_example: aliyun dbfs list-auto-snapshot-policies --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --filter-key PolicyName --filter-value policyTest --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAutoSnapshotPolicies

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region. To view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions, call DescribeRegions (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)

parameters.help_en: The page number for paged queries. Default value: 1

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paged queries. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页条数。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The filter key to use when querying resources.

Use with FilterValue. Valid values: PolicyId or PolicyName.

If you specify PolicyId, the system filters by automatic snapshot policy ID. If you specify PolicyName, the system filters by automatic snapshot policy name
parameters.help_zh:
查询资源时的筛选键。

与FilterValue配合使用，取值必须为PolicyId或PolicyName。

传入PolicyId则根据自动快照策略ID进行筛选，传入PolicyName则根据自动快照策略名称进行筛选
parameters.name: filter_key

parameters.help_en:
The filter value to use when querying automatic snapshot policies.

Use with FilterKey
parameters.help_zh:
查询自动快照策略时的筛选值。

与FilterKey配合使用
parameters.name: filter_value

RepeatWeekdays.description_en:
The list of weekdays on which to create automatic snapshots. Valid values: 1 to 7, where 1 represents Monday.

Specify values as a JSON array. For example, ["1"] creates automatic snapshots every Monday.

To create automatic snapshots multiple times per week, specify up to seven values separated by commas. For example, ["1","3","5"] creates automatic snapshots every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday
RepeatWeekdays.description_zh:
自动快照的重复日期列表，单位为天，周期为星期。取值范围：1~7，例如1表示周一。格式说明：

传入的参数需要保持JSON数组格式。例如，["1"]表示每周一重复创建自动快照。

当一星期内需要创建多次自动快照时，可以传入多个时间点，时间点之间用半角逗号（,）隔开，最多传入7个时间点。例如，["1","3","5"]表示每周一、周三、周五重复创建自动快照

items.description_en: The weekday on which to create automatic snapshots
items.description_zh: 自动快照的重复日期，周期为星期

RetentionDays.description_en: The number of days to retain snapshots. Valid values: 1 to 65535. A null value means retain indefinitely until the quota limit is reached and older snapshots are automatically deleted
RetentionDays.description_zh: 快照保留天数（1-65535，NULL为持续保存，直至快照数量达到额度上限后被自动删除）
RetentionDays.title_en: 快照保留天数（1-65535，NULL为永久保存）
RetentionDays.title_zh: 快照保留天数（1-65535，NULL为永久保存）

StatusDetail.description_en: Detailed status information if the status is abnormal. This field is empty when Status is normal
StatusDetail.description_zh: 若出现异常的状态信息详情，status为normal时为空

TimePoints.description_en:
The list of times at which to create automatic snapshots. Times use UTC+8 and are specified in hours. Valid values: 0 to 23, representing 00:00 to 23:00. For example, 01 represents 01:00.

Specify values as a JSON array. For example, ["1"] creates an automatic snapshot at 01:00.

To create automatic snapshots multiple times per day, specify up to 24 values separated by commas. For example, ["01","03","15"] creates automatic snapshots at 01:00, 03:00, and 15:00
TimePoints.description_zh:
自动快照的创建时间点列表。使用UTC +8时间，单位为小时。取值范围：0~23，代表00:00至23:00共24个时间点，例如01表示01:00。格式说明：

传入的参数需要保持JSON数组格式。例如，["1"]表示01:00创建自动快照。

当一天内需要创建多次自动快照时，可以传入多个时间点，时间点之间用半角逗号（,）隔开，最多传入24个时间点。例如，["01","03","15"]表示01:00、03:00、15:00时创建自动快照

items.description_en: The time at which to create an automatic snapshot
items.description_zh: 自动快照的创建时间点
